html:
During summer months your home can get quite warm with the sun streaming in and the glare can sometimes mean you need to pull the curtains closed or the blinds down.

Solar window film helps to reduce heat and glare eliminating the need to use curtains or blinds so you can enjoy the view from your home’s windows and still have natural light entering your home. Below, discover the additional benefits you can enjoy with solar film for home windows.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. We offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications and our films (which are exclusive to us) are government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality. Here are the benefits of our solar film for homes

Benefits Of Solar Film For Home Windows

In addition to reducing heat and glare, there are many other benefits to having solar control window film installed in your home. Depending on the type of film you choose, benefits include:

  • A warmer home in winter (creating a more comfortable year-round temperature – you’ll notice a positive difference in your power bills too!)
  • Protection for you and your family from harmful UV rays
  • A reduction in premature fading of the carpets, floorboards and furnishings in your home
  • Privacy (stop those on the outside from seeing into your home)
  • Reduced reflections on screens in your home

All solar film for home windows are installed by professionally trained installers and if you would like the benefits of solar control window film without altering the appearance of your home, we have lighter shades of film available.

We also have safety & security films that hold shattered glass together helping to prevent break-ins and keeping your family safe from injury if the glass is broken.

Get A Quote For Solar Film For Your Home Today
